holes_in_opposing_case: STRONGEST CLAIM (value-guy): CA-US 2Y/2027H1 SOFR-CORRA at ~140bp is a 4th-percentile 5y cheap-Canada dislocation that must compress, so US rates and USD go lower while CAD goes higher. HOLE: FACT the 5d cheapening was US 2Y +13bp versus CA 2Y -4bp after a delivered Fed hike, not a Canada-collapse shock. Compression via the US-down leg contradicts SOFR 3.85, gauges 72/75/69, August CPI tightening bias, and SR3 still only peaking at 4.735. Compression via the CA-up leg needs BoC to deliver the 84-136bp hike path against CPI-trim/median 1.9/2.0, employment -42k, and wages +2.0% y/y. Value-guy's own 2024-12-18 analog at -130bp WIDENED 20bp over 3m. FACT the 2028 gap is already ~98.5bp; 2027H1 remaining cash-like is a split-regime price, not proof the US terminal is too high.

perma-bull: pay CORRA_2027-03 because global tightening/energy forces Canada catch-up, yet USD lower and CAD higher. HOLE: the same FACT cluster (Fed hike, BoJ 1.25%, BoE 6-3, energy absorbers weaken) is the overlay that supports a higher US terminal and USD, which they also mark us_rates_view higher. Using one shock to pay Canada and to sell USD is internally split. Overnight SOFR-CORRA is 156bp; USDCAD 1.401 is only 74th 1y / 87th 5y. CAD-up versus USD is not required for a Canada hiking residual, and core-at-target plus jobs -42k still cap how far CRAH27 can be squeezed above 3.13 without the US peak also rising.

cross-merchant: short AUDCAD as CAD higher plus AUD lower. HOLE: hawk agrees the AUD leg (housing stamp duty -24%, volumes -18%, home values more than 7% off peak). CAD higher is the extra claim. It requires either delivered BoC catch-up that labor/core have not printed, or a fade of USD-driven CAD weakness while SOFR-CORRA cash remains 156bp. AUDCAD at a 5y extreme can correct through AUD/USD without CAD rallying against USD.

mean-reverter: CAD higher is a passenger on a receive-AONIA_2027-03 housing fade. HOLE: receiving Mar-27 AONIA does not identify a CAD-up mechanism. Their ca_rates_view is lower, which is the opposite of a CAD-supportive policy story. The CAD-higher tag is unlinked to their own rates expression.

trend-follower: AUD higher while paying SOFR_2027-03. HOLE: they are an ally on US rates, not on AUD. FACT AU unemployment 4.5%, employment -15.8k, housing already contracting, AONIA still +51 to +59.5bp into 2027. Higher AU yields with a biting housing channel are AUD-negative financial conditions, not an AUD-up trend. 99th-percentile AU yields are the tightening, not a reason to bid AUD.
attack: The routed conflicts are FX views, not an opposite SOFR_2027-09 book. The only opponent who actually needs US terminal lower for their trade is value-guy (long SOFR-CORRA_2Y_2027H1, canonical long profits when the SOFR-minus-CORRA mark falls). That RV is a two-legged bet: US implied rates down and/or Canada implied rates up. The US-down leg is the one that would hurt a pay of SR3 2027-09.

FACT: US inflation 72, labor 75, activity 69, consumer 74; core PCE still ~3.0% 6m annualized; unemployment 4.1% unchanged; ISM services 55.4 with new orders above 60; Fed already at 3.75-4.00% with SOFR 3.85; SR3 peaks 4.735 then eases ~21bp. INFERENCE: the US-down compression leg is the weaker leg. If Canada catches up, SOFR-CORRA can compress while the US peak still rises; that would make value-guy right on the spread and still leave paying 2027-09 intact. UNKNOWN: whether energy pass-through shows up in the next Canadian core print.

perma-bull's CAD-up/USD-down pairing is the second-strongest FX attack and fails the same test: they invoke global tightening to pay CORRA, then drop USD. A hawk keeps the tightening overlay on the US reaction function. Cross-merchant and mean-reverter do not own a US-terminal view at all; their CAD-higher tags do not falsify SR3 4.735 being too low. Trend-follower's AUD-higher tag is a housing-channel error, not a reason to cover US STIR.
defense: DEFEND the Round-1 expression: short SOFR_2027-09 / pay implied rate. FACT the live US policy path still peaks at 4.735 and then fades. The hawk disagreement remains that 6m PCE, non-breaking labor/services, and the energy/global-tightening overlay leave that peak and easing tail too low. Currency views (USD higher, CAD lower, AUD lower) are secondary inferences from that US-terminal view plus a still-wide 156bp cash SOFR-CORRA gap and AU housing stress. They are not the trade.

WHAT WOULD CONCEDE the SOFR book: SR3 2027-09 implied rate prices a peak below 4.735 while US unemployment leaves 4.1% higher and ISM services/new orders lose expansion, or post-hike Fed language treats 3.75-4.00% as terminal as 6m core PCE cools through the observed ~2.4% 1m/3m pace. WHAT WOULD CONCEDE the FX tags without forcing a SOFR cover: BoC actually delivers the 84-136bp path while US 2Y stops rising, which could lift CAD versus USD; that is a CAD-US relative outcome, not automatic proof the US peak is too high.

UNCERTAINTY KEPT: US 2Y/5Y already 99th 1y after +57/+51bp 1m; Q2 GDP +1.5% SAAR; Michigan 47.8; CFTC null; only ~21bp of post-peak ease is priced, so the larger error may be extra hikes rather than the fade. That is why the book is HOLD of pos-c9184707c12b ($50m, $500k shock) rather than ADD. Carry still opposes a pay of 4.735 versus overnight 3.85 if the extra restriction is not delivered.
No winner is named. Allies on USD-up (dollar-king, carry-is-king, rate-dove, trend-follower) are not treated as confirmation. ChatGPT is the arbiter.

policy_path_check.rationale: Short-end US policy pricing is present and is the right starting point before sovereign 2Y/5Y/10Y. The hawk discrepancy lives in the US peak/easing tail (4.735 then fade), not in Canada where 136bp of hikes are already priced against CPI-trim/median at 1.9/2.0% and wages/employment cooling, nor in Australia where only ~60bp more is priced but housing volumes/stamp duty are already contracting and AU 2Y/5Y/10Y are 99th percentile.

stir_policy_path.rationale: FACT: SR3 2027-09 at 4.735 is the observable US terminal/peak, +88.5bp vs SOFR 3.85, then the strip eases. That is the cleanest markable expression of underpriced extra hikes or delayed easing. CA CORRA and AU AONIA are inferior: Canada already prices ~136bp of hikes with core at target and labor weakening; Australia prices ~60bp more but housing is biting and AONIA liquidity thins past the front months.

two_year.rationale: FACT: US 2Y 4.76, +57bp 1m, 99.8th 1y / 88th 5y, close to the SR3 peak. Paying 2Y is a valid higher-front-end expression, but a 2Y percentile is not a substitute for the policy path and the 1m rerating is already extreme.

five_year.rationale: FACT: US 5Y 4.86, +51bp 1m, 99.6th 1y and 5y. It can pay if the hiking cycle extends through 2027, but it mixes term premium with policy and is already at a historical extreme.

ten_year.rationale: FACT: US 10Y 5.01, 99.6th 1y / 99.9th 5y, only +36bp 1m. The hawk view is a reaction-function/terminal argument, not a 10Y duration or term-premium argument; this tenor is the wrong owner and already stretched.

curve.rationale: FACT: US 2s10s 25bp at 0.2nd 1y percentile (-21bp 1m). Extra hikes would flatten further, delayed easing can steepen, and the curve is already at a 1y extreme. Mixed hawk implications plus no room as a flattener make curve a poor expression.

cross_market_rv.rationale: FACT: CA-US 2Y -140bp at 3.8th 1y / 4.3rd 5y; CA-US 5Y -124bp at 0.2nd 1y. Paying US versus Canada is already an extreme. BoC minutes flag energy pass-through, which would reprice CORRA higher and compress the spread. NZ RV is unavailable (RBNZ B2 403). AU-US 2Y +26bp is not a 1y extreme.

rates_tenor_scan.selection_rationale: The discrepancy is the US policy-path peak and the unearned easing tail after a delivered hike. SOFR_2027-09 is the liquid SR3 contract at that peak. 2Y/5Y are valid but already 99th-percentile sovereigns and are not substitutes for the strip. Curve and CA-US RV fight already-extreme levels and mixed country residuals.

Prefer rates when both expressions are usable; here rates are strictly cleaner and the seat already owns the SR3 contract. Round-2 FX conflicts (USD-down/CAD-up/AUD-up) do not make spot the cleaner owner of the terminal disagreement.
